verdict.rationale: Only community evidence touches developer tooling. Users praise built-in command-line utilities (pbcopy/pbpaste, fs_usage, networkQuality), describe the notarization/stapler workflow, and report running toolchains like terraform. One user says synchronous network checks on exec made commands take minutes to start, which is a real limitation rather than a contradiction. missing for 10: any evidence of IDE support, AI/ML framework or software support, macOS being a primary supported target for current toolchains, first-party developer docs, and independent corroboration of toolchain performance.
